Definition: {seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number}
BiblicalUsage: Seven in Aramaic counts the king's counsellors, the furnace heated seven times hotter, and the seven times that pass over Nebuchadnezzar until he knows the Most High rules. The number marks completeness in the court of Babylon, just as it does in the rest of Scripture.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe seven is God's number of fullness, and Babylon could not escape it even when it tried to use it against His people. I hold that the times appointed over kings and kingdoms are in His hand, and seven times is exactly as long as He says.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
